label: TP
reason: Assessed alert paths: 1) java/insecure-randomness - The insecure randomness source (nextInt) flows to rememberMeKey which is used as a session token, making it vulnerable to prediction. 2) java/xss - User-provided cookie value flows into HTML output via response.getWriter() without proper encoding, creating a cross-site scripting vulnerability. Both alerts are exploitable on their respective paths.

evidence.note: nextInt() used to generate rememberMeKey, which is stored as a session cookie
User-provided cookie value flows directly into HTML response output
